verdict.rationale: Mem0's core product surface (add/search/update/delete memories, webhooks, exports, graph memory, entity scoping, expiration) is exposed via REST API/SDK and mirrored in the CLI and MCP tools, with the dashboard positioned as a viewer/audit layer on top of the same API rather than a source of exclusive functionality. Runtime probes confirm the CLI and OpenAPI spec are real and agent-drivable end to end. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every dashboard-only control (e.g. account/billing settings) has an API equivalent, and independent (non-vendor) verification of full UI/API parity.
